title: Defence Situation Room
purpose: Security and command surfaces; decisive-authority messaging.
story: A defence situation room in low light — the apparatus of grave decision held in readiness, dark and disciplined.
environment: A windowless command room, a long table ringed by chairs, dark screens lining the walls without content.
architecture: Secure modern interior — a low acoustic ceiling, recessed wall bays, a glazed observation gallery dim at the rear.
composition: The command table on the central axis under one low warm pool, dark wall bays receding into negative space, the gallery barely lit.
continuityNotes: Matches the set's near-black grade; all screens stay dark and blank while one warm lamp carries the brass-on-black accent from scene-01.
